note: The proposal reply, recorded as an objection: Carnap makes adopting a linguistic framework a practical decision, not an assertion. That does not by itself falsify PrincipleInOwnScope (which says only that the formulation is in scope): the bridge from nonassertive adoption to the formulation's lying outside the scope it governs is open and unattributed (docs/ayer-verification-boundary.md). LOGIC-SELF-APPLICATION-SCOPE-NEEDED shows only that nothing follows once the scope premise is dropped.
